title: Fretboard notes between sessions
description: Short tasks that tie the name of a note to a string and a fret.

blocks.text: On the move you can go over where the notes are, even with no guitar at hand.

quote.text: I am practicing on guitar as mush as possible, but throughout the day I am also getting in mental exercises with this app (I use it without the guitar). It all seems to be working. I am really seeing the fretboard now

blocks.text: Alternate recognition with finding the position, and reveal the answer through a specific string and fret. At the end, give a short passage to repeat on the instrument.
Progress in the game is not the same as being able to play it: carrying it over to the guitar takes practice of its own.
